content: पैशाच {%a.%} (-ची|{%f.%}) [पिशाचेन निर्वृत्तः अण्] Demoniacal, infernal. .{@-चः@} .²1 The eighth or lowest of the eight forms of marriage in Hindu law, in which a lover ravishes a maiden without her consent when she is sleeping, or intoxicated, or deranged in intellect; सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा रहो यत्रोपगच्छति . स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां पैशाचश्चाष्टमो ऽधमः <ls>Ms. 3. 34</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 61</ls>. .²2 A kind of demon or पिशाच. .{@-ची@} .²1 A present made at a religious ceremony. .²2 Night. .²3 A sort of gibberish spoken on the stage by demons. .²4 One of the forms of Prākṛta.
